spans.s: To feel aversion or dislike, be unwilling or disinclined to do anything (with inf.).
To be fatigued or wearied, feel tired or exhausted.

To despond, sink in spirit, be dejected; नाऽवकल्प्यमिदं ग्लायेद्
 यत् कृच्छ्रेषु भवानपि
To wane, fade, faint away. ━Caus. (ग्ल-ग्लपयति, but प्रग्लापयति)

To cause to fade away, wither up; ग्लपयति यथा शशाङ्कं न तथा
 हि कुमुद्वतीं दिवसः Ś. 3. 16;
To emaciate, waste; व्रतैः स्वमङ्गं ग्लपयन्त्यहर्निशम्
